properties.description: Hosting platforms where each subdomain is a different party's site, such as free website hosts, site builders and dynamic DNS services. A threat intelligence listing under one of these keeps its severity instead of becoming informational for sitting under a popular domain. This list is replaced on every solution update; add platforms in a watchlist you create with the alias WhoisXMLHostingPlatformsCustom.
